concepts.label: Pending vBucket
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - a third vBucket lifecycle state (alongside the already-promoted vbucket:active-vbucket and vbucket:replica-vbucket) holding items while a vBucket is mid-transfer, e.g. during rebalance. Minted once at the state level, not once per one of its ~19 mirrored stat fields (vb_pending_num, vb_pending_curr_items, vb_pending_queue_*, etc.), which stay as prose/evidence detail.

relations.subject: server/8.0/cli/cbstats/cbstats-all
relations.evidence: For a complete list of `common options`, see the table provided on the introductory page for [cbstats](../cbstats-intro.md#common-options).

notable_absence.finding: Unlike cbstats-config.md, which explicitly notes '(Note that the `ep_magma` statistics are returned on Couchbase Server Enterprise Edition only.)', this page's own worked example returns numerous ep_magma_* fields (ep_magma_wal_buffer_size, ep_magma_num_flushers, ep_magma_commit_point_interval, ep_magma_max_write_cache, etc.) with zero mention anywhere on this page that they are Enterprise-Edition-specific - an inconsistency in caveat coverage between two sibling pages that report overlapping fields.

cross_component_finding: This page is the only one in the batch that explains the 'ep' prefix at all: 'Note that `ep` stands for _eventual persistence_, and simply refers to the Data Service.' Every other cbstats page in this batch (memory, config, diskinfo, kvstore, reset) uses ep_-prefixed stat names extensively but never defines the prefix themselves - a reader who lands on any of those sibling pages without also having read this one has no on-page way to learn what 'ep' means.
cross_product_finding: Not applicable - no cross-product content on this page.
